blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) and cortical superficial siderosis (cSS) are imaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease, but their automated segmentation is limited by the scarcity of positive cases and voxel-level annotations. We propose a synthetic training framework for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation that requires no real lesion annotations for training and leverages radiological description of the lesions. Starting from anatomical brain parcellations, the framework applies spatial augmentation and voxel resampling, procedurally inserts cSS and CMB labels using clinical priors on lesion location and morphology, and synthesises images through randomised intensity assignment, blurring, and Rician noise simulation. Models were trained on dynamically generated image–label pairs and evaluated against manual delineations in 10 cSS cases and 13 CMB cases. The proposed configurations outperformed classical filter baselines. For cSS, the hypointensity-constrained model achieved higher AUPRC and AUROC than the Frangi filter (AUPRC: 0.284 vs 0.083; AUROC: 0.907 vs 0.731). For CMBs, explicit synthesis of blood vessels as lesion mimics improved performance over the classical baseline (AUPRC: 0.538 vs 0.004; AUROC: 0.999 vs 0.968). These results support our proposal as a feasible strategy for data-scarce haemorrhagic lesion segmentation.
blocks.zh: 大脑微血(CMB)和皮质表面侧面(cSS)是脑小血管病的成像标记,但由于阳性病例和阴性水平说明的稀少,它们的自动分化受到限制. 我们提出一个长尾出血性损伤分解的合成训练框架,不需要真正的损伤说明来进行培训,并利用对损伤的放射描述。 从解剖大脑分解开始,框架采用空间增强和病毒再生,程序上采用cSS和CMB标签,对损伤位置和形态进行临床前科,并通过随机强度分配、模糊化和Rician噪声模拟合成图像。 对模型进行了关于动态生成的图像-标签配对的培训,并根据10个计算机辅助系统案例和13个CMB案例的人工划界进行了评估。 提议的配置超过了经典过滤基线。 对于cSS,低强度受限模型实现了比Frangi滤波器更高的AUPRC和AUROC(AUPRC:0.284 vs 0.083;AUROC:0.907 vs 0.731)。 对CMB来说,血管作为损伤模拟的明确合成比经典基线提高了性能(AUPRC:0.538对0.004;AUROC:0.999对0.968)。 这些结果支持了我们的建议,认为它是进行数据缺血性损伤分解的可行战略。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) and cortical superficial siderosis (cSS) are magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) markers of cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD), a major contributor to stroke, vascular cognitive impairment, dementia, and haemorrhagic adverse events during anti-amyloid therapies [ 8 , 5 , 15 , 6 , 13 ] . Accurate quantification of CMB and cSS burden is therefore important for characterising CSVD severity, stratifying haemorrhagic and dementia risk, assessing treatment eligibility, and monitoring disease progression and treatment safety.
blocks.zh: 大脑微血症(CMB)和皮质表面侧面(cSS)是脑小血管疾病(CSVD)的磁共振成像标记,是抗酰胺疗法期间中风,血管认知障碍,痴呆,出血不良事件的主要促成因素[8,5,15,6,13]. 因此,准确量化CMB和CSS的负担对于确定CSVD的严重程度、确定出血和痴呆风险、评估治疗资格以及监测疾病进展和治疗安全性十分重要。

blocks.en: When large, heterogeneous annotated datasets are available, standard supervised segmentation pipelines such as nnU-Net can achieve strong lesion-segmentation performance [ 11 ] . This premise, however, breaks down for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion-segmentation tasks such as CMB and cSS segmentation. Positive cases are uncommon even in clinically relevant cohorts, with reported prevalences below 3% for cSS [ 14 ] and below 20% for CMBs in memory-clinic settings [ 7 ] . Moreover, lesion voxels are extremely sparse, and lesion burden can range from a few isolated voxels to disseminated involvement across the whole brain [ 8 ] . Building representative training datasets therefore requires targeted expert case identification and voxel-level annotation across diverse cohorts, both of which are laborious and resource-intensive. For CMBs and cSS, such large, diverse, publicly available datasets remain unavailable, motivating alternative training strategies for data-scarce, long-tail lesion segmentation.
blocks.zh: 当有大而多样的附加说明的数据集时,如nnU-Net等标准有监督的分块管道可以实现强烈的分块性能[11]. 然而,这一前提因诸如CMB和CSS分化等长尾出血性损伤-分化任务而破裂. 即使在临床相关人群中,阳性病例也不常见,CSS[14]报告的流行率低于3%,CMB在内存临床环境中的流行率低于20%[7]。 此外,阴道炎病毒极为稀少,从几个孤立的阴道炎病毒到在整个大脑中传播参与的疾病负担可能不等。 因此,建立有代表性的培训数据集需要有针对性地鉴定专家案例,并在不同群体中进行排毒水平的注释,这两个群体都是费力和资源密集型的。 对于CMB和CSS来说,如此庞大、多样、公开的数据集仍然无法提供,这推动了数据稀缺和长尾损伤分解的替代培训战略。

blocks.en: Synthetic training addresses this bottleneck by generating image–label pairs rather than requiring manual annotation for every training example. This strategy has proven effective when the target structures are already available as label maps, such as anatomical regions, tissue classes, or existing lesion masks [ 9 , 10 , 12 , 1 , 2 , 4 ] . For CMBs and cSS, however, voxel-level lesion labels are precisely missing, limiting the direct applicability of standard synthetic training frameworks.
blocks.zh: 合成训练通过生成图像-标签对来解决这个瓶颈问题,而不是要求每个训练例子需要手动注释。 事实证明,如果目标结构已经作为标签地图提供,例如解剖区域、组织类别或现有的损伤口罩[9、10、12、1、2、4],这一战略是有效的。 然而,对于CMB和CSS来说,确切地说,缺氧水平的损伤标签,限制了标准合成培训框架的直接适用性。

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose to extend synthetic training to data-scarce haemorrhagic lesion segmentation by procedurally generating the missing CMB and cSS labels themselves using clinical and imaging priors on lesion morphology, anatomical distribution, MRI appearance, and acquisition variability. Evaluation against manual delineations across two datasets supports this approach for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation in data-scarce settings.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提议将合成培训扩大到数据缺血性损伤分解,在程序上利用关于损伤形态、解剖分布、核磁共振外观和获取变异性的临床和成像前科,生成缺失的CMB和CSS标签。 对照两个数据集的人工划界进行评价,有助于在数据稀缺环境中进行长尾出血损伤分解。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: The following sections describe the proposed synthetic data generation framework (Fig. 1 ). In brief, anatomical parcellations are first spatially augmented to increase anatomical and voxel-size variability. cSS and CMB labels are then inserted using lesion-specific anatomical and morphological priors. The resulting lesion-augmented maps are converted into synthetic images through randomised intensity assignment, blurring, and noise simulation, and finally paired with binary lesion masks for network training.
blocks.zh: 以下各节介绍拟议的合成数据生成框架(图1)。 简言之,解剖分解首先在空间上得到扩展,以增加解剖学和阴道大小的可变性. 然后使用损伤性特定解剖学和形态学前科插入cSS和CMB标签。 由此产生的损伤增强图通过随机的强度分配,模糊化,噪声模拟等方法转化为合成图像,最后与二进制损伤口罩配对进行网络训练.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Proposed synthetic image generation pipeline for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation.
blocks.zh: 图 1:拟合成影像生成管道,用于长尾出血损伤分解.

blocks.en: 2.4 Final synthetic image-label pair
blocks.zh: 2.4 最后合成图像标签配对

blocks.en: Training synthetic image–mask pairs ( I final , Y ) (I_{\mathrm{final}},Y) are constructed by using I final I_{\mathrm{final}} as the input image and binarising S i final S_{i}^{\mathrm{final}} to isolate the target cSS/CMB label.
blocks.zh: 训练合成图像 - mask 配对(I final, Y) (I_{\ mathrm{final}},Y) 是通过使用 I final I_{\ mathrm{final}} 作为输入图像和 binarising Si final S_{i}^{\ mathrm{final}})来构建的,以隔离目标cSS/CMB标签.

blocks.en: 3 Training and evaluation
blocks.zh: 3 培训和评价

blocks.en: 3.1 Training
blocks.zh: 3.1 培训

blocks.en: Brain parcellations. We used a pool of 840 brain parcellations derived from Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) scans. Parcellations were generated with SynthSeg [ 1 ] and SIAM [ 17 ] , which provides labels to guide cSS and CMB placement, respectively.
blocks.zh: 脑部分裂 我们用了一个来自阿尔茨海默氏病神经成像计划扫描的840个脑包。 SynthSeg [1] 和SIAM [17] 生成了折叠,它们分别提供标签来指导cSS和CMB的放置.

blocks.en: Generation parameters. Brain parcellations were spatially augmented with affine transformations (scaling ± 20 % \pm 20\% , rotation ± 15 ∘ \pm 15^{\circ} , shearing ± 0.012 \pm 0.012 ) and nonlinear elastic deformations (displacement-field std 3.0, control-point scale 0.0625). To mimic acquisition variability, volumes were randomly resampled to isotropic resolutions of 0.5–1.2 mm or anisotropic resolutions with 0.5–1.2 mm in-plane and 1.2–4.0 mm through-plane spacing. For cSS, 3–20 lesions were generated from sampled seeds using geodesic propagation, with a base cost of 1.0, noise weight of 0.25, and 𝝆 ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 10 , 30 ) \boldsymbol{\rho}\sim\mathcal{U}(10,30) voxels. For CMB, radii were sampled uniformly from 1–5 mm, with 1–4 lesions per crop. In both cases, S ​ N ​ R d ​ B SNR_{dB} was drawn from a uniform distribution 𝒰 ⁡ ( 10 ​ d ​ B , 40 ​ d ​ B ) \mathcal{U}(10~dB,40~dB) .
blocks.zh: 生成参数. 脑部的切片在空间上得到了加固,伴有芳香变形(缩放±20%\pm 20\\,旋转±15\pm 15\circ},剪切±0.012\pm 0.012)和非线性弹性变形(迁移-场积3.0,控制点尺度0.0625). 为了模仿获取的变异性,量被随机复制到0.5-1.2毫米的异热带分辨率或无同位素分辨率,在飞机中为0.5-1.2毫米,在飞机间距为1.2-4.0毫米。 对于cSS,使用大地测量仪传播的样本种子产生3至20个损伤,基价为1.0,噪声重量为0.25,而ρU(10,30)\boldsymbol\rho\sim\mathcal{U}(10,30) voxels。 对CMB来说,光度从1至5毫米统一取样,每个作物有1至4个损伤。 在这两种情况下,SN R d B SNR_{dB}都是从统一分配U (10 d B,40 d B)\mathcal{U}(10~dB,40~dB).

blocks.en: Segmentation network. We used a five-level 3D U-Net backbone. Each block comprised two convolutional layers with batch normalisation and ELU activations. The encoder used max-pooling for downsampling, the decoder used upsampling, and skip connections preserved local spatial detail. Voxel-wise predictions were produced with a final softmax layer. The model was implemented in PyTorch/MONAI and trained for 70 epochs, with 1,000 on-the-fly synthesised image–label pairs per epoch and a batch size of 2 2 . Optimisation used Adam with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} . To address severe class imbalance, training minimised a soft Dice loss with a squared denominator and dynamic inverse-volume weighting [ 1 , 3 ] . Training took approximately 24 hours on an NVIDIA A100 GPU.
blocks.zh: 分化网. 我们用了一个五级的三维U网骨干. 每个区块由两个具有批量正常化和ELU激活的转录层组成. 编码器使用最大集合进行下采样,解码器使用上采样,跳过连接保留了局部空间细节. 以最终软max层产生Voxel-wise的预测. 该模型在PyTorch/MONAI中实施,培训对象为70个纪元,每个纪元有1000个飞行合成图像–标签对,批量大小为2,2. 优化使用亚当的学习率为10 - 5 10 - 5 。 为解决班级严重失衡问题,培训将软虱损失减少到最低程度,并有方分母和动态反量加权[1、3]。 在NVIDIA A100 GPU的训练上大约用了24小时。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价

blocks.en: Test cases and ground truth. For cSS, evaluation used an in-house test set of 10 patients with confirmed cSS (6 females; median age 74.5 [IQR 67–78] years) scanned with susceptibility- or T2*-weighted MRI. Lesions were manually delineated by a trained investigator and validated by an experienced neuroradiologist. For CMBs, evaluation used 13 T2*-weighted scans from the ALFA cohort made available through the MICCAI 2021 VALDO Challenge [ 16 ] , under the corresponding ethics approval and data use agreements.
blocks.zh: 测试案件和事实 对于CSS,评价采用由10名经证实的CSS患者(6名女性;年龄中位数74.5岁[IQR 67-78]岁)扫描后易感性或T2*加权核磁共振的内测组。 一名训练有素的调查员手动划定了利西翁,并由一名有经验的神经放射学家验证。 对于CMB,评价使用13个T2*加权扫描,来自ALFA组群,通过MICCAI 2021 VALDO Challenge [16]提供,依据相应的道德操守审批和数据使用协议.

blocks.en: Ablation experiments. To quantify the effect of key generation choices, we performed ablation experiments. First, we compared fully randomised label intensities with the proposed intensity prior that enforces cSS and CMB hypointensity, testing whether preserving haemorrhagic signal dropout improves segmentation beyond anatomical and morphological randomisation alone. Second, we compared image-only input with input augmented by a Laplacian filter response, testing whether an explicit cue for dark lesion-like structures improves learning. Under the adopted sign convention, hypointense structures yield positive Laplacian responses, highlighting candidate CMB and cSS patterns while preserving the original synthetic image information. Third, we also evaluated lesion-specific refinements motivated by observed failure modes. For CMBs, false positives frequently occurred along blood vessels; we therefore tested whether including blood vessel labels from SIAM during synthesis improved robustness to hypointense vessel-like structures. For cSS, errors tended to occur at the CSF–cortical boundary. We therefore tested whether a two-class target formulation improved separation between cSS and CSF.
blocks.zh: 潜伏实验. 为了量化关键生成选择的效果,我们进行了消化实验。 首先,我们把完全随机化的标签强度与执行 cSS 和 CMB 低强度之前的拟议强度进行比较,测试保留出血信号的中断是否改善了解剖和形态随机化之外的分化。 第二,我们比较了仅图像输入和Laplacian滤波器反应增强的输入,测试类似黑暗损伤结构的明确提示是否改善了学习。 根据通过的标志公约,低温结构产生积极的拉普拉西亚反应,突出候选CMB和CSS模式,同时保留原始合成图像信息. 第三,我们还评估了由观察到的故障模式引起的针对损伤的改进。 对于CMB来说,假阳性经常在血管上出现;因此,我们测试在合成过程中是否将SIAM的血管标签包含在增强强度到低强度的类似血管的结构上。 CSS方面,错误往往发生在CSF-正边界。 因此,我们检验了双类目标配方是否改善了中央支助系统与中央支助系统之间的分离。

blocks.en: Comparison against other methods. For cSS, no established method provides fully automated segmentation. The closest existing approach is a semi-automated Frangi-filter-based method [ 18 ] , which we therefore used as comparator. For CMBs, we also used the Frangi as the corresponding classical baseline.
blocks.zh: 与其他方法的比较。 对于cSS,没有既定的方法提供完全自动化的分区. 现有最接近的方法是半自动的弗朗吉-滤镜法[18],因此我们作为比较者使用. 对于CMB,我们也使用弗兰吉号作为相应的古典基线.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. Segmentation performance was evaluated using threshold-free metrics: area under the precision–recall curve (AUPRC) and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). These metrics allow comparison with classical non-probabilistic baselines, such as the Frangi filter.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度。 采用无阈值的衡量标准评估了分块性能:精度-召回曲线下的区域(AUPRC)和接收器操作特征曲线下的区域(AUROC)。 这些度量衡可以与经典的非概率基线进行比较,如弗朗吉滤波器.

blocks.en: 4 Results and discussion
blocks.zh: 4. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Results are shown in Figs. 2 – 3 and discussed in the following sections.
blocks.zh: 调查结果见图。 2–3,并在以下各节讨论.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Quantitative evaluation of framework components for cSS and CMB segmentation. Forest plots show median AUPRC and AUROC with interquartile ranges for each approach. The proposed hypointensity prior improved performance for both lesion types, while explicit blood-vessel synthesis led to the best CMB performance.
blocks.zh: 图 2: CSS和CMB分割框架组成部分的定量评价。 森林地块显示AUPRC和AUROC的中位数,每种方法都有方位范围。 拟议的低强度在两种损伤类型之前都提高了性能,而明确的血流体合成则导致了CMB的最佳性能.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Visual comparison of segmentation performance. Columns show, from left to right, the original MRI scan, zoomed-in view, manual ground-truth annotation, Frangi filter output, and outputs from the four ablation configurations: random intensity sampling, Laplacian prior, cSS/CMB hypointensity constraint, and lesion-specific refinement. The lesion-specific refinement corresponds to a two-class target for cSS and blood-vessel synthesis for CMBs.
blocks.zh: 图3:分区性能的视觉对比. 列显示从左到右的原磁共振扫描,缩放视图,手动地面真实注释,弗朗吉滤波器输出,以及四个衰竭配置的输出:随机强度采样,拉普拉西安前,cSS/CMB低强度约束,以及损伤特异性的改进. 病变特异性的改进符合CSS和CMB的血母合成的双级目标.

blocks.en: Random intensities vs intensity prior. Fully randomised intensity sampling yielded substantially lower performance than the proposed hypointensity prior for both cSS and CMB segmentation, especially for AUPRC (cSS: 0.086 [IQR 0.028–0.152] vs 0.284 [IQR 0.124–0.363]; CMB: 0.024 [IQR 0.002–0.446] vs 0.261 [IQR 0.056–0.431]), while AUROC remained largely unchanged. This suggests that enforcing haemorrhagic-lesion hypointensity improves precision in the sparse lesion class by ranking true lesion voxels higher among lesion-like candidates and reducing false positives. In contrast, fully randomised intensities make the synthetic task less aligned with blood-sensitive MRI.
blocks.zh: 随机强度对强度前 。 完全随机的强度采样的性能大大低于CSS和CMB分区化之前的拟议低强度,特别是AUPRC(cSS:0.086 [IQR 0.028-0.152] vs 0.284 [IQR 0.124-0.363];CMB:0.024 [IQR 0.002-0.446] vs 0.261 [IQR 0.056-0.431]),而AUROC基本上保持不变。 这表明,实施出血-血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血小血 相比之下,完全随机的强度使得合成任务与血液敏感核磁共振不太一致.

blocks.en: Image prior only vs image and Laplacian prior. Although the Laplacian channel was intended to provide an explicit cue for local hypointense structures, it also enhanced non-lesion features, including vessel boundaries and sulcal interfaces. Consequently, adding the Laplacian prior degraded performance relative to the image prior alone for both lesion types (cSS AUPRC: 0.063 [IQR 0.023–0.222] vs 0.284 [IQR 0.124–0.363]; CMB AUPRC: 0.117 [IQR 0.014–0.192] vs 0.261 [IQR 0.056–0.431]). These findings suggest that the constrained synthetic images already encoded sufficient intensity and morphological information, whereas the Laplacian channel introduced a less specific representation that impaired transfer to real data.
blocks.zh: 图像前仅对图像和Laplacian前。 虽然Laplacian频道旨在为当地低沉结构提供明确的提示,但它也加强了非流线特征,包括船只边界和淤泥界面。 因此,将Laplacian先前的退化性能与以前的图像相比,增加两种损伤类型(cSS AUPRC:0.063 [IQR 0.023-0.222] vs 0.284 [IQR 0.124-0.363];CMB AUPRC:0.117 [IQR 0.014-0.192] vs 0.261 [IQR 0.056-0.431])。 这些调查结果表明,受限的合成图像已经编码了足够的强度和形态信息,而拉普拉西亚通道则引入了不太具体的表示,从而妨碍了向真实数据的转移。

blocks.en: cSS-specific refinements. For cSS, visual inspection showed that errors frequently occurred at the CSF–cortical boundary, particularly when cSS was adjacent to sulcal CSF. To address this failure mode, we tested an alternative target formulation in which CSF was modelled explicitly as a separate class, alongside background and cSS, rather than training only a binary cSS-versus-background model. However, this modification produced little numerical change. AUPRC was similar for the binary cSS target and the explicit-CSF formulation (0.284 [IQR 0.124–0.363] vs 0.273 [IQR 0.116–0.347]). This suggests that most boundary errors were not primarily caused by the absence of an explicit CSF class, but may instead reflect the intrinsic ambiguity of thin hypointense structures at the cortical surface, partial-volume effects, and the limited spatial separation between cSS and adjacent CSF.
blocks.zh: cSS的特有改进。 对于CSS来说,目视检查表明,CSF-正边界经常发生错误,特别是在CSS与sulcal CSF相邻时。 为了解决这种故障模式,我们测试了一种备选目标配方,在这种配方中,CSF与背景和cSS一起被明确模拟为一个单独的班级,而不是只培训一个二进制cSS-相对于背景模型. 然而,这一修改并没有产生多少数字变化。 AUPRC对于二进制cSS目标和显式CSF配方(0.284 [IQR 0124-0.363] vs 0.273 [IQR 0.116-0.347])是类似的. 这表明大多数边界误差并非主要因缺乏明确的CSF类而引起,而是可能反映皮层表面薄的低强度结构的内在模糊,部分量效应,以及CSS和相邻的CSF之间的空间分离有限.

blocks.en: CMB-specific refinements. For CMBs, visual inspection showed that false positives often occurred along cerebral blood vessels, which can also appear hypointense on blood-sensitive MRI. To address this failure mode, we tested whether explicit vessel modelling during synthesis improved robustness. Because SynthSeg does not provide vascular labels, SIAM parcellations were used to introduce vessels as a separate anatomical class in the synthetic label maps. This CMB-specific refinement substantially improved performance, increasing AUPRC from 0.261 [IQR 0.056–0.431] to 0.538 [IQR 0.470–0.723]. This suggests that explicitly modelling relevant lesion mimics during synthetic training is important for reducing false positives.
blocks.zh: CMB特有的完善. 对CMBs来说,视觉检查显示,大脑血管上经常出现假阳性,在对血液敏感的核磁共振上也可能显得低度. 为了解决这种故障模式,我们测试了在合成过程中的明显容器建模是否提高了强度。 由于SynthSeg不提供血管标签,SIAM包裹被用于在合成标签图中引入血管作为单独的解剖类. CMB特有的改进大大提高了性能,使AUPRC从0.261[IQR 0.056-0.431]增加到0.538[IQR 0.470-0.723]. 这表明,在合成训练中明确模拟相关损伤对减少假阳性很重要。

blocks.en: Comparison against other methods Compared with the classical filter baseline, the best synthetic-training configurations showed higher median AUPRC and AUROC for both lesion types. For cSS, the hypointensity-constrained model achieved higher AUPRC than the Frangi filter (0.284 [IQR 0.124–0.363] vs 0.083 [IQR 0.017–0.114]) and higher AUROC (0.907 [IQR 0.879–0.935] vs 0.731 [IQR 0.676–0.811]). For CMBs, the model trained with blood-vessel synthesis achieved higher AUPRC than the classical filter baseline (0.538 [IQR 0.470–0.723] vs 0.004 [IQR 0.002–0.032]) and higher AUROC (0.999 [IQR 0.997–1.000] vs 0.968 [IQR 0.944–0.978]). Together, these results indicate better discrimination of the sparse positive class, with a more favourable balance between true-positive lesion voxels and false-positive detections, as reflected by AUPRC. The higher AUROC further suggests improved lesion-versus-background ranking across thresholds, although this metric is less sensitive to false positives in highly imbalanced voxel-wise segmentation.
blocks.zh: 与其他方法的比较 与古典滤波基线相比,最好的合成-训练配置显示两种损伤型的AUPRC和AUROC中位数较高。 对于cSS,低强度受限型号实现的AUPRC比Frangi滤波器(0.284 [IQR 0.124-0.363] vs 0.083 [IQR 0.017-0.114])更高,AUROC(0.907 [IQR 0.879-0.935] vs 0.731 [IQR 0.676-0.811])更高. 对CMB来说,经过血流体合成培训的模型实现了比经典滤波基线更高的AUPRC(0.538 [IQR 0.470–0.723] vs 0.004 [IQR 0.002–0.032])和更高的AUROC(0.999 [IQR 0.997–1.000] vs 0.968 [IQR 0.944–0.978]). 这些结果表明,少数阳性阶层受到更好的歧视,真实阳性阴道损伤和假阳性检测之间取得了更有利的平衡,非盟炼油中心就反映了这一点。 较高的AUROC进一步表明,跨阈值的损伤与背景排名有所改进,虽然这一指标对高度不平衡的阴性分化中的假阳性反应不太敏感。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced a synthetic training strategy for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation and demonstrated its feasibility for CMB and cSS quantification. By procedurally generating lesion labels from anatomical and imaging priors, the proposed framework enabled model training without real voxel-level lesion annotations. Experimental results showed agreement with manual delineations across two datasets. Future work will evaluate the approach in larger, more heterogeneous cohorts and extend it from segmentation to lesion detection.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了长尾出血性损伤分解的合成培训战略,并展示了对CMB和CSS量化的可行性。 通过在程序上从解剖学和成像学前科中产生损伤标签,拟议的框架使模型培训得以进行,而没有真正的阴道级损伤说明。 实验结果显示,双方同意手工划分两个数据集。 今后的工作将用更大、更多样化的组群来评价这一方法,并将它从分化扩大到发现损伤。
